capabilities: Create or reopen notes by dragging .msg or .ics calendar files onto a ribbon icon
Resolve dates for recurring events, with a confirmation dialog when needed
Customize filenames and note templates with Mustache syntax and helper functions
Quote and escape imported text to keep YAML properties valid
Configure the target folder and invalid-character handling for filenames
disambiguation: Does not sync or connect to Outlook live; notes are created only from .msg or .ics calendar files you drop onto the icon, and plain .msg emails do not import.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the settings page includes documentation links and a Buy me a coffee button.
intentEvidence: Based on Outlook Meeting Notes by David Ingerslev. This fork adds support for recurring events, opening existing notes
motivation: The author forked Outlook Meeting Notes to add support for recurring events, opening existing notes, and other improvements.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Outlook calendar appointments and meetings into notes, and existing tooling lacked recurring-event support.
